appearances.title: UBTree: parallel tree drafting gives about 3.4x faster decoding for Ling-3.0, with drafters released on Hugging Face
appearances.summary: A unigram proposer suggests candidate tokens and a bigram selector links them into a draft tree built fully in parallel. On Ling-3.0-flash (124B) with 4 GPUs it reports about 1,010 output tokens per second at concurrency 1, a 3.43x average end-to-end speedup over plain decoding across six benchmarks. Drafters for Ling-3.0-tiny-8B and Ling-3.0-flash-124B are out now, with more promised.
